newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah recovers on intervention.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah recovers on intervention.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah bounced back to 2,595 against the dollar after the central bank intervened in the market, dealers said.
One Japanese bank dealer said the central bank was seen selling dollars in the market but had no idea of volumes.
One local bank dealer said the central bank was selling dollar outright.
Currency dealers in Singapore said they heard the central bank was in the market but could not confirm the news.
Dealers said the rupiah recovered to 2,595 against the dollar from a historic low of 2,650/55 after a 2,510/20 open.
The rupiah tumbled to its largest one-day fall, about 140 points, following speculative attacks by offshore players.
